articles.title: Akte Josef Mengele: Schweizer Geheimdienst öffnet Akte über KZ-Arzt Mengele überraschend
articles.teaser: Lange war die Akte über den »Todesengel von Auschwitz« unter Verschluss. Jahrelang kämpften Historiker um Einsicht – jetzt geben die Behörden nach.
articles.image_title: Akte Josef Mengele: Dr Joseph Mengele (Angel of Death), fugitive ex-Nazi, who was reported to have been captured by police at a jungle settlement in San Martin Province, 600 miles from here. Hans Kugler, chief prosecutor at the Auschwitz War Crimes trial in Frankfurt where 22 lesser officials of the extermination camp are on trial, said that Mengele had been the prosecution's number one most wanted man. Mengele, a physician, presided over the massive Gestapo Medical Experiments on women and children at the Nazi Death Camp. He is also accused of helping make the Auschwitz mass gassings "scientifically perfect". Informed sources said that Mengele was operating a prosperous agricultural business in the settlement of Tambo at the time of his arrest. - 6th June 1964

French President Emmanuel Macron and UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer chair a meeting of allies to consider sending a multinational force to ensure security and free-flowing trade in the Strait of Hormuz once the current conflict between Iran and the US and Israel ends. articles.image_title: Hantavirus auf der MV Hondius: Transmission electron micrograph of the Sin Nombre hanta virus. Hantaviruses that cause Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) are carried in rodent droppings, especially the deer mouse. Incubation lasts for 1-5wks. Sickness begins with fever and muscle aches, followed by shortness of breath and coughing.

articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); WM-Finale 1970: Der beste Weltmeister, den es je gab
articles.teaser: Jogo bonito. Mit ihrem WM-Sieg 1970 begründen die Brasilianer um Pelé ihren Ruf als Meister des schönen Spiels. Nirgendwo wird das so deutlich wie bei diesem einen Tor.
articles.image_title: WM-Finale 1970: FILE - Brazil's Pele is hoisted on the shoulders of his teammates after Brazil won the World Cup final against Italy, 4-1, in Mexico City's Estadio Azteca, June 21, 1970. A Brazilian dictionary has added “Pelé” as an adjective to use when describing someone who is “exceptional, incomparable, unique.” The announcement by the Michaelis dictionary on Wednesday, April 26, 2023, is part of a campaign that gathered more than 125,000 signatures to honor the late soccer great’s impact beyond his sport. (AP Photo, File)
